verdict.rationale: Jules ships an official documented API (developers.google.com/jules/api) with API key management, session/task creation, plan approval, and automation mode fields, explicitly positioned for building custom workflows and integrations (Slack, Linear, GitHub). Community evidence corroborates real-world use of the API to build a custom MCP server integration. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec or llms.txt (probes returned 404s), and no SDKs in multiple languages are documented, only a REST-style API.
